title: Raccoon Creek Boat Rental
specs: Ramp for easy and safe kayak access on and off the water
Weight limits vary by boat type, e.g. single kayak 225-325 lbs, double kayak 550 lbs, canoe up to 725 lbs
Anyone under 18 must have release form signed by an adult
Large groups like scouts or company outings should call in advance to reserve boats and staff

includes: Life jackets provided, Coast Guard approved in all sizes
blurb: Guests rent various boats including kayaks, canoes, hydrobikes, rowboats, motor boats, standup paddleboards, and mini pontoon boats to enjoy on the water. A special ramp is provided for easy and safe access on and off kayaks. Life jackets are provided and Coast Guard approved in all sizes.
tags: 14 ft. Boat with trolling motor additional hour
extraNote: Rentals are first come first served except fishing boats at trout season and large groups by reservation · Dogs allowed on boats, kayaks, canoes but not on standup paddleboards or mini pontoon boats · Boating allowed in rain unless thunder or lightning; must wait 30 minutes after thunder/lightning before returning on water · Military, veterans, and first responders may get discounts by notifying staff
